text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Takarazuka Kinen fast approaching, we spot Bamboo Memory hard at work training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki chides her for pushing herself too far, but Bamboo Memory insists that it's best to always go all out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then mentions how calm Yaeno Muteki is during her races, and that she can't help but feel like she's got more to give in races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, before the Takarazuka Kinen, Inari One similarly teases Yaeno Muteki for being so calm despite the upcoming race. It seems she also believes Yaeno Muteki is holding back.
